## Abstract

This GeoEpi project brings together automated tools for NWS risk assessment and support of APHIS operational decision making. Registered work includes geostatistical modeling, cellular automata, data processing, dashboard pipelines, and a group NWS repository.

<article class="geoepi-subproject-card">
### Bayesian NWS Geostatistical Model

Joint spatiotemporal modeling of NWS occurrence and intensity.

<a href="https://github.com/geoepi/hominivorax-geostat">Canonical repository <span aria-hidden="true">&#8599;</span></a>

</article>
<article class="geoepi-subproject-card">
### NWS Cellular Automata

Initial Cellular Automata spread model, driven by environmental suitability and connectivity (no pop dynamics).

<a href="https://github.com/geoepi/hominivorax-CA">Canonical repository <span aria-hidden="true">&#8599;</span></a>

</article>
<article class="geoepi-subproject-card">
### Pipeline for CDS Data Processing

Automated pipeline for retrieving and preprocessing clinate and environmental rasters from the Climate Data Store (CDS).

<a href="https://github.com/geoepi/cds-datagrab">Canonical repository <span aria-hidden="true">&#8599;</span></a>

</article>
<article class="geoepi-subproject-card">

Pipeline for reformmating NWS modeling results for use in Tableau dashboard.

<a href="https://github.com/geoepi/nws-postprocessing">Canonical repository <span aria-hidden="true">&#8599;</span></a>

</article>
